description.en: The ID of the ENS edge node.
The instance type of the NAT gateway. Set the value to **enat.default**.

description.zh: NAT网关名称。长度为1~128个字符，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The name of the NAT gateway. The name must be 1 to 128 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The tags to add to the resource.

description.zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为**1**~**20**。

- 不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
- 最多支持64个字符。
- 不允许传入空字符串。
description.en:
The tag key. A resource can have up to **20** tags.

- The tag key cannot be an empty string.

- The tag key must be 1 to 64 characters long.

- The tag key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.

description.zh: 资源的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag value. The value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters long. The value cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-nat-gateway --name name --ens-region-id cn-suzhou-telecom --network-id n-5qj7ykuxmjn7k96l090sp0000 --vswitch-id vsw-5savh5ngxh8sbj14bu7n0000 --instance-type enat.default --tag Value=Deep Key=team --instance-billing-cycle example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CreateNatGateway --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key team --VSwitchId 'vsw-5savh5ngxh8sbj14bu7n0000' --Tag.1.Value Deep --InstanceBillingCycle 'example-string' --EnsRegionId 'cn-suzhou-telecom' --NetworkId 'n-5qj7ykuxmjn7k96l090sp0000' --InstanceType 'enat.default' --Name name
